name: feature_framework_bind

ownership.argument: Second half of the registration chain. The only host field it touches is host+0, and it only stores it; nothing is dereferenced during registration.

provenance.source: Allocates the 136-byte FeatureManagerQjs object, runs the base constructor 0xC8656D8(manager, registry), overwrites the vptr with off_2CDA2CE4 (= vtable 0xCDA2CD0 + 0x14), then builds a 148-byte adapter 0xC860F08(*(host+0)) - which stores host+0 as that adapter's field 0 and fills its callback table at +8..+68 - and attaches it with 0xC865734(manager, adapter). One caller: feature_registry_create 0xC8660E4.

notes: Second half of the registration chain. The only host field it touches is host+0, and it only stores it; nothing is dereferenced during registration.
